- `GET /en-us/wp-json/{wp-jsonId}/experience/v1/navigation` — Retrieve navigation data.

- `POST /api/v3/ip.json` — Update IP address information.
- `POST /idx/clerr` — Log a client-side error.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Salesforce's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Salesforce data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.salesforce.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Salesforce frontend uses
